## Instructions

Keep this sheet all day. The instructors do not collect it. Do not write confidential or personal data, or the names of people who are not in the room.

1. **Morning, alone.** Fill in the Research Use Card. Your **Research Use** is one actual or planned use of generative AI in your research. The term stays the same all day.
2. **After the four Lens inputs.** Write the Lens that fits your Research Use best on the card.
3. **Lens group.** Introduce your card. Apply the four questions of your Lens to each Research Use.
4. **Panarchy Block 1, alone.** Turn the sheet over. Write your **challenge** in one sentence: what must change to make your Research Use more responsible? List the **influences**.
5. **Block 1, pairs.** Sort your influences into **levels**. Compare your levels.
6. **Block 1, groups of four.** Present your challenge. Select one challenge. Use Sheet 2, front, part A.
7. **Block 2, pairs.** Examine the open challenges. Use Sheet 2, front, part B.
8. **End of the day.** Complete your Action Plan on Sheet 2, back. A peer reviews it.

[This sheet: CC BY-SA 4.0 · Stochastic Parrots and Beyond, Laura Wagner and Moritz Mähr. The Panarchy Chart is adapted from Liberating Structures.]{.content-visible when-format="typst"}

## Panarchy Chart

![](../../assets/handouts/panarchy-chart-sheet.svg){fig-alt="Panarchy Chart for one participant. At the top, a field for the challenge in one sentence. On the left, a ruled field for the influences: people, rules, tools, money, habits. On the right, five horizontal bands from level 1, small and fast, at the bottom to level 5, large and slow, at the top. Each band has a field for its level name. An arrow on the left points up: ideas and experiments spread up. An arrow on the right points down: resources and rules flow down." width="92%"}

::::: {.content-hidden when-format="typst"}

To type your chart, use the fields below or the Word version. Level 1 is small and fast. Level 5 is large and slow.

::: {.worksheet}

| Field                        | Notes |
| ---------------------------- | ----- |
| Challenge (one sentence)     |       |
| Influences                   |       |
| Level 5: name and influences |       |
| Level 4: name and influences |       |
| Level 3: name and influences |       |
| Level 2: name and influences |       |
| Level 1: name and influences |       |

: Panarchy Chart fields {tbl-colwidths="[34,66]"}
